items.title: NorthStar leads new ESA project on re-entry prediction
items.summary: NorthStar Earth & Space’s Luxembourg office said Monday it will lead a second research team funded by the European Space Agency (ESA), this one working out where and when objects re-entering the atmosphere without control will land. The project , called FALCON (Forecasting of Atmospheric Location and Chronology of Re-entry), will assess where today’s re-entry forecasts fall short and build a framework for probability-based estimates of timing and landing zone.
